dossier.headline: Consumer staples become the market's top sector
dossier.summary: FMCG has been a steady support through November, led by ITC and Tata Consumer in mid-month. On 25 Nov it became the day's standout sector, reaching a three-month high and reclaiming its 200-day average as HUL rose about 4% and ITC about 2.6% on foreign buying.
why_it_matters: FMCG cushioned the market when the morning rally faded on 25 Nov
HUL and ITC together make up nearly half the sector index, so two stocks drive most of its moves
